description: The plot illustrates the comparison of Macro-F1 scores for MATTER and a model without material knowledge during tokenization training with varying numbers of tokens. The x-axis is labeled "Number of tokens" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.6 to 1.4, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 48 to 58, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot contains two lines: a purple line with circle markers and a solid style representing MATTER, and a pink line with circle markers and a solid style representing the model without material knowledge. The purple line starts at approximately 54% at 0.6 on the x-axis, remains relatively steady around 54% until 1.2, and then declines to around 50% at 1.4. The pink line starts at around 53% at 0.6, peaks at approximately 57% at 1.0, and then declines to around 50% at 1.4. Both lines have shaded regions around them, indicating the range of values.
